Alex: Heads-up — planning a microrelease (tide) for FE-327 into release wave 3 today. Target deploy window 2025-06-01 13:30 PT. Need a smoke volunteer + quick rollback readiness check.

Maya: I can take smoke. Quick Q — is there any DB migration or long-running task?

Dinesh: I'll own rollback/watch. What exact deploy command are we running and where's the runbook?

Alex: No DB migration, it's a config toggle + new frontend bundle. Deploy command (local canary):
```
./release-train deploy --wave=3 --package=fe-327 --env=prod --canary=2
```
I'll add the runbook snippet to the release manifest in a minute.

Jen: Small ask — ping me when the PR is merged. I'll update the release manifest and tag the release, then kick off the orchestration trigger. Also planning a quick perf smoke after the canary.

DeployBot: Deploy slot reserved: wave-3 @13:30 PT by Alex. Ticket created: #REL-420. :white_check_mark:

Maya: :thumbsup: I'll run the smoke checklist at 13:35 PT — health endpoints, traces sampling, 95th latency, error-rate, and a couple of user-flow checks. Will post results in this thread.

Dinesh: Rollback plan: revert to previous canary image fe-327-prev if error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m or any 5xx spike. Rollback helper: 
```
./rollback.sh --wave=3 --to=fe-327-prev
```
I'll be ready to execute and notify infra.

Alex: CI is green. Plan: merge at 12:50 PT, tag and trigger deploy. Any objections to timeline?

Jen: No objections. I'll be on watch 13:20–14:00 and will run the post-canary perf checks.

Maya: All good from my side.

Dinesh: Good to go — adding notes to the deploy board and leaving my pager window 13:15–14:15.

Alex: Thanks all — I'll post the merge + tag here when done.
